notes.title: [11/27] New Update for Space Needle VR!
notes.content:
[b]What's new:
[/b]
- Simpler, more intuitive teleport mechanism
- New loading screen
- Elevator button now has feedback
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: We're excited to announce a new and improved VR experience for Space Needle!
notes.content:
- A newly designed, cozy coffee shop will greet you at start of the experience
- Improved visuals and graphics on ground level and on top of Space Needle
- Redone menus and improved teleport mechanics
- Includes extreme version of bungie jump (not for the faint of heart!)
- We now support the Oculus Rift!
- Numerous bug fixes and stability improvements ːsteamhappyː
